final_message:
The octahedron design is saved at `designs/octahedron.sc` and submitted. `check_design` reports no errors and 95.6% of the scaffold paired. I did not run a 3D shape check against the 3.5 nm criteria, so the octahedron fit is unverified.

- **Geometry:** Vertices sit at ±24.75 nm on the three axes, giving 35 nm edges. Each of the 12 edges is a helix group of two 84-bp helices, centred on the edge midline and 1.3 nm either side of it, tangent to the surface. Yaw, pitch and roll come from the edge direction.
- **Scaffold:** 2108 nt of M13mp18 (rotation 5587). It is an Eulerian circuit over the doubled octahedron graph, so each edge is run once on each of its two helices. Consecutive helices are joined at vertices by 4-nt unpaired loops. The closing hop is left open, so the scaffold is linear.
- **Staples:** Each edge has full crossovers at offsets 22, 43 and 64 (21 bp apart). The two middle rings are nicked once, giving 48 staples of 40–44 nt, all within the 18–60 nt limit.
- **Open issues:** Only the scaffold joins the edges at vertices; there are no vertex staples. The scaffold's 92 unpaired bases are the loops at the vertices.
